name: Signature

components.expression: a grounded, intense stare, the weight of the earth in her gaze.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Terrador, visible in the distance among the trees, an Elder Dragon of terracotta-ochre and rich-bronze scales, trailing drifting dust and stone fragments, wings like slabs of weathered stone edged in warm sand

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses proven cross-cutting wardrobe pieces (gown, jewelry set, heels, ornate staff, ambient glow) in Draknara's own Terracotta Ochre/Rich Bronze palette, plus the existing ancient-grove background (fits Earth/Shaman thematically). Shortcut per explicit instruction: no unique signature item yet beyond the shared defaults -- can be swapped for something more bespoke later.
